title: api-evangelist
description: Sixteen years of API research as MCP tools — stories, areas, governance blocks & services
summary: Sixteen years of API research as MCP tools — stories, areas, governance blocks & services
offersHint: Sixteen years of API research as MCP tools — stories, areas, governance blocks & services · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.apievangelist.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_overview
toolsPreview.description: START HERE. What the API Evangelist network offers: sixteen years of API research as searchable stories, 77 topic areas, governance building blocks (guidance, rules, policies, standards, strategies), papers, conversations, and the consulting services Kin Lane offers teams. Returns counts, entry points, and how to engage.

toolsPreview.name: guide_topic
toolsPreview.description: PRO — Curated guide to one API topic (e.g. "gateways", "api governance", "discovery", "agents"). Bundles the matching topic area (with related areas), top guidance, rules, policies, and standards, relevant papers and recent stories, plus the API Evangelist services that can help a team with this topic.

toolsPreview.name: find_services
toolsPreview.description: The services API Evangelist offers teams and customers — API strategy, governance, discovery, and evangelism engagements by Kin Lane. The front door to working with API Evangelist. (For the third-party vendor registry, use find_solutions.)

toolsPreview.name: get_service
toolsPreview.description: Full detail for one service offering by slug; include=["content"] inlines the full pitch.

toolsPreview.name: find_solutions
toolsPreview.description: The solutions registry — 740+ third-party API services and tools (gateways, portals, testing, monitoring, …) ranked by adoption across the companies API Evangelist tracks.

toolsPreview.name: get_solution
toolsPreview.description: One solution from the vendor registry by slug, with its website and adoption count.

toolsPreview.name: find_tools
toolsPreview.description: The open-source tooling registry — 400+ tools in use across the companies API Evangelist tracks, each with adoption counts and technology-radar placement.

toolsPreview.name: get_tool
toolsPreview.description: One tool from the tooling registry by slug, with its website, adoption count, and radar ring.

toolsPreview.name: get_contact
toolsPreview.description: Every way to reach API Evangelist — email, contact form, newsletter, GitHub, social channels, and postal mail.

toolsPreview.name: search_api_evangelist
toolsPreview.description: Unified search across the whole network: 5k+ stories, 77 topic areas, 2.5k governance building blocks, papers, conversations, videos, tools, timelines, services, and vocabulary. Filter with types (posts, areas, guidance, rules, policies, standards, strategies, schema, properties, experiences, lifecycle, conversations, videos, papers, services, solutions, tools, timelines, vocabulary).

toolsPreview.name: find_posts
toolsPreview.description: Search or browse 5,100+ API Evangelist stories (2010–present); filter by year or tags.

toolsPreview.name: get_post
toolsPreview.description: One story by slug (YYYY-MM-DD-slug); include=["content"] returns the full markdown body.

toolsPreview.name: find_areas
toolsPreview.description: The 77 focused topic areas of the network (agents, gateways, security, …), each a subsite with its own catalog.

toolsPreview.name: get_area
toolsPreview.description: One topic area with its related-area graph resolved — walk the network from here.

toolsPreview.name: find_building_blocks
toolsPreview.description: Search the governance building blocks by type: guidance (177), rules (617), policies (283), standards (432), strategies (75), schema (11), properties (790), experiences (46), lifecycle (29).

toolsPreview.name: get_building_block
toolsPreview.description: One building block by type + slug; include=["content"] returns the full body.

toolsPreview.name: find_conversations
toolsPreview.description: API Evangelist Conversations — recorded discussions with API practitioners (guest, company, YouTube/SoundCloud links).

toolsPreview.name: get_conversation
toolsPreview.description: One conversation with guest detail and media links; include=["content"] returns the writeup.

toolsPreview.name: find_papers
toolsPreview.description: API Evangelist white papers — deep dives distilled from sixteen years of research, with outlines.

toolsPreview.name: get_paper
toolsPreview.description: One paper with its full outline and purchase/landing URL.

toolsPreview.name: find_videos
toolsPreview.description: The API Evangelist video library — interviews and discussions from across the API space, searchable by transcript.

toolsPreview.name: get_video
toolsPreview.description: One video by slug with its YouTube id; include=["content"] returns the full transcript.

toolsPreview.name: get_timeline
toolsPreview.description: One of the four research timelines in chronological order: api (the moments that shaped web APIs), resources (which digital resources became APIs and when), industries (the industrial history framing API infrastructure), people (the people who made compute and APIs possible).

toolsPreview.name: get_guidance_section
toolsPreview.description: One editorial guidance section as a list: history, technology, business, politics, governance, or evangelism — the six lenses API Evangelist organizes guidance through.

toolsPreview.name: find_vocabulary
toolsPreview.description: The API vocabulary — thousands of resources, actions, personas, domains, schemas, and tags extracted from the API landscape. Filter by category.

toolsPreview.name: get_feeds
toolsPreview.description: The static machine-readable feeds every network site publishes (JSON, APIs.json, zero-auth) — the no-key alternative to this API.

toolsPreview.name: find_tags
toolsPreview.description: Browse and rank the network tag taxonomy — every subject tag across 16k+ docs, by frequency or breadth (how many content types use it). Search with q. The map of what API Evangelist covers.

toolsPreview.name: get_tag
toolsPreview.description: One tag with its per-type counts and everything it labels across the whole network (stories, areas, guidance, papers, …). Filter with types.

toolsPreview.name: find_related
toolsPreview.description: Given any doc (type + slug), the most related content across the whole network, ranked by shared-tag relevance (rare, specific tags weigh most). "More like this," across stories, areas, guidance, papers, conversations, and more.

toolsPreview.name: get_stats
toolsPreview.description: PRO — catalog intelligence: per-type counts, stories-per-year, and the top tags by reach across the network.

toolsPreview.name: find_company_insights
toolsPreview.description: Browse profiled companies (Fortune 1000 + API providers) by name; ranked by technology-readiness signal. Free.

toolsPreview.name: insights_dimensions
toolsPreview.description: Cross-section ranking of the 40 tracked investment dimensions (AI, cloud, governance, …) by company signal. Free.

toolsPreview.name: insights_adoption
toolsPreview.description: Services, tools, or standards ranked by how many companies adopt them. Free.

toolsPreview.name: get_company_insight
toolsPreview.description: Full demand-side profile for one company: 40-dimension readiness, adopted stack, per-quarter history. Pro.

toolsPreview.name: company_gaps
toolsPreview.description: A company's weakest investment dimensions — where it is thin. Pro.

toolsPreview.name: validate_api
toolsPreview.description: Lint an OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, Arazzo, or JSON Schema document against the curated best-of-breed ruleset (Spectral) and return the findings. Pass your own `ruleset` to run rules you own instead of the catalog — which is what you should do before gating on anything.

toolsPreview.name: api_coverage
toolsPreview.description: Measure how much of an API description your governance actually inspects — coverage by section, each rule's reach, and the rules that match nothing. Like test coverage, one altitude up.

toolsPreview.name: reconcile_waivers
toolsPreview.description: Reconcile a waivers file against lint output: suppress sanctioned violations and surface the expired, stale, and expiring ones. Returns the effective failing set a build should gate on.

toolsPreview.name: governance_report
toolsPreview.description: Turn Spectral findings into a self-contained HTML governance report — severity summary, grouped by rule, framed toward progress.

toolsPreview.name: verify_certificate
toolsPreview.description: Re-verify a governance certificate against the API it attests to. If the API drifted or the certificate was forged, verification fails.

toolsPreview.name: classify_api_fields
toolsPreview.description: Inventory the PII, secret, and sensitive fields an OpenAPI exposes, across parameters and request/response schemas. Run this before exposing an API to agents.

toolsPreview.name: diff_api_versions
toolsPreview.description: Compare two OpenAPI versions and classify every change as breaking, non-breaking, or an addition — at path, operation, parameter, request-body, and response granularity.

toolsPreview.name: api_scorecard
toolsPreview.description: Score an API's maturity 0-100 with a letter grade across design, governance coverage, documentation, and (from an apis.json) discoverability, agent-readiness, and operations. Pass your own `ruleset` — a score against rules you never adopted means little.

toolsPreview.name: govern_estate
toolsPreview.description: PRO — Run the core governance checks across a WHOLE SET of internal APIs and roll them up: per-API score/grade/errors/PII, plus estate aggregates (avg score, grade distribution, APIs with PII/secrets) and a worst-first punch-list of what to fix. Pass `apis` ([{id, document}]) and your own `ruleset`. detail:true adds per-API dimensions.

toolsPreview.name: deprecation_posture
toolsPreview.description: Report every deprecated operation and whether it actually announces a sunset. The ones that go quiet are the ones that break consumers.

toolsPreview.name: validate_onboarding
toolsPreview.description: Validate an API Onboarding Descriptor (AID) against the api-commons schema and report which optional sections it fills in.

toolsPreview.name: certify_api
toolsPreview.description: Issue a tamper-evident governance certificate attesting an API passed a named ruleset at a profile threshold. A SHA-256 fingerprint lets anyone re-verify it.

toolsPreview.name: export_agent_rules
toolsPreview.description: Turn a governance ruleset into agent-native guidance — an AGENTS.md block, a system-prompt set, a per-rule remediation pack, and a digest — so agents follow the rules while authoring, not after linting.

toolsPreview.name: audit_pipeline
toolsPreview.description: Score a repository's Spectral CI setup against an 8-point maturity rubric and return a prioritized punch-list. Pass a public `repo` ("owner/name") or `files`.

toolsPreview.name: forge_mcp_tools
toolsPreview.description: From an OpenAPI, forge an MCP server design, per-operation tools, Agent Skills, an enriched OpenAPI, a server.json, and apis.json properties.

toolsPreview.name: gate_agent_context
toolsPreview.description: Choose which operations and fields an API exposes to agents and emit a governed Tyk OpenAPI, an MCP tool manifest, and a Spectral ruleset with PII and secret checks.

toolsPreview.name: apply_overlay
toolsPreview.description: Apply an OpenAPI Overlay to a document and report what each action matched. Use it for deprecation and migration choreography without forking the contract.

toolsPreview.name: mock_payloads
toolsPreview.description: Generate an example request and success-response payload for every operation from its schema.

toolsPreview.name: code_snippets
toolsPreview.description: Generate runnable curl, JavaScript, and Python samples for every operation, with path params filled in and a realistic body.

toolsPreview.name: score_reusability
toolsPreview.description: Score how reusable a set of APIs is and detect duplication across them — the anti-sprawl view of an estate.

toolsPreview.name: map_api_experience
toolsPreview.description: Map each REST operation to its MCP tool and Agent Skill — the API -> MCP -> Agent-Skill chain — from an APIs.json, with a free/paid coverage scorecard and a flow map.

toolsPreview.name: generate_agent_descriptor
toolsPreview.description: Generate an API's llms.txt and an AGENTS.md consumption contract — base URL, auth, the operation table, deprecated operations to avoid, and usage rules.
